hypotheses.title: Larch staging preflight requirements and service-specific verification
hypotheses.body: For every Larch staging operation, the operator must inspect the complete preflight report, confirm that all staged migration checks passed, and record the verification identifier before applying any changes. The service-specific verification commands are `larch verify alpha`, `larch verify beta`, and `larch verify gamma` for alpha, beta, and gamma respectively. Production deployment is outside the scope of this staging procedure.
limitations: Applies only to Larch staging in project:6a9669f391b4d184db903f6a; it does not define a production deployment procedure.
The three commands are service-specific variants, not interchangeable commands or evidence that all three must run for every operation.
